text:
ada: Heads-up — I'm prototyping "role templates" in the console that bundle RBAC + sensible routing/telemetry defaults for new tenants. Goal: one-click safe defaults for PLG accounts that hit Dedicated later. Thoughts?

ben: curious — what exactly is bundled? routing policy, quotas, and audit labels?

ada: yes. plan is templates = {roles, default route-affinity, quota-presets, telemetry-tags}. Example use case: create Tenant X -> apply "startup-default" -> routes get low-cost model + caching TTL + telemetry tag tenant:startup

claire: love the idea but worried about migration. existing tenants have custom route overrides. how do we avoid overwriting?

ada: migration plan: templates are opt-in and only populate new entities. for existing tenants we surface a "suggested template" banner in Settings > Permissions; that banner uses a dry-run preview API.

sam: can we keep the preview in the console small? product doesn't want a huge diff screen. maybe a compact preview list: "will add role Y, adjust route Z quota -> 80%" and an expand for details.

li: API question — are we adding a new preview endpoint or reusing routes preview? Backend shapes matter for caching/telemetry.

ben: my vote is new endpoint: POST /v1/tenants/:id/template-preview. Reason: isolates logic and makes audit logs cleaner. Also allows a boolean param ?apply_changes=false for dry-run.

claire: separate endpoint is fine but please don't duplicate entitlement evaluation logic. reuse the evaluator module (EvaluatorService) so results match actual apply.

ada: agreed. pseudo request:

```
POST /v1/tenants/abc/template-preview
{
  "template": "startup-default",
  "dry_run": true
}
```

response will be a compact list of actions + conflict hints.

sam: related UX ask — show cost delta estimate. ops says we can approximate token cost delta for route changes.

li: telemetry: templates should add a stable tag key e.g. "rbac_template=startup-default" so we can correlate regressions during rollout. Add that to trace spans and cost reports.

ben: rollout plan: create template, enable for internal sandbox tenants first, then opt-in for customers. We should have a canary toggle that auto-applies to 2% of new signups for 24h.

ada: canary is good. need a console affordance for toggles and a sampling metric in Console -> Telemetry (new row: "template_canary_sampled").

claire: also add an audit entry for when a template is applied or suggested. We need immutable records for entitlements changes per compliance.

devops-bot: deploy pipeline: feature/role-templates -> staging at 2025-06-12T09:10:00Z

sam: microcopy: "Apply template will add recommended roles and route defaults. Review before applying. This will not remove your existing overrides." keeps people safe.

li: one more: avoid latent permission explosion. templates should not auto-grant admin-level scopes. default role should be least-privilege. maybe a "preview impact" that flags any role that includes sensitive API scopes.

ada: yep. preview will include a "sensitivity" score per role and require explicit checkbox to accept anything >= HIGH.

ben: for backend impl, I'll add endpoint and wire it to EvaluatorService + AuditService. I'll also emit metrics: template.preview.count, template.apply.count, template.apply.latency.

claire: for migrations later, allow a "reconcile" job that suggests converting existing custom groupings into the closest template and surfaces differences for review.

sam: UI checklist:
- compact preview summary
- expand for diffs
- estimated cost delta
- sensitivity warnings
- apply + schedule apply (defer for 1h / nightly)

ada: thanks all. next steps: ben to draft API PR, sam to sketch compact preview UI, li to add telemetry tag plan, claire to write audit requirements. I'll kick off a short doc in Confluence and drop link here when ready.

ben: will send API sketch by EOD.

ada: cool — tagging @here for any other objections. :thumbsup:
